Your work will span Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent LLM orchestration, auto-captioning, generative media, and content moderation.

You’ll use frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, and Google’s Agent Development Kit to build persistent, scalable AI services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a full-stack AI role that spans intelligent backend APIs, LLM agent orchestration, and integration with product-facing features.

Build and deploy multi-agent AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, or Google’s Agent Development Kit.
Implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, semantic chunking, and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate).
Integrate hosted and open-source LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Ollama, Mistral) into intelligent systems.
Build REST APIs with FastAPI and internal tools with Streamlit to expose AI functionality.
Deploy production-grade services on GCP using Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, and Pub/Sub.
Embed AI into platform features such as auto-captioning, LuupForge (generative studio), feed personalization, and real-time moderation.
Maintain modular, testable, observable, and secure code across the AI system lifecycle.
Requirements

3+ years experience in applied AI/ML engineering (production-level deployments, not research-only).
Strong Python development skills with full-stack AI engineering experience:
FastAPI, Streamlit
LangGraph, LangChain, or similar
PyTorch, Transformers
FAISS, Weaviate, or Pinecone
Solid experience working with hosted APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) and self-hosted models (Mistral, Ollama, LLaMA).
Deep understanding of LLM orchestration, agent tool-use, memory sharing, and prompt engineering.
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP); especially Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub.
Familiarity with best practices in cloud-based software development: containerization, CI/CD, testing, monitoring.
Nice to Have

Experience with Google’s Agent Development Kit or similar agent ecosystems.
Familiarity with multimodal AI (e.g., handling text, image, audio, or video content).
Prior experience developing creator platforms, content recommendation engines, or social media analytics.
Understanding of ethical AI principles, data privacy, and bias mitigation.
Experience with observability tools (e.g., Sentry, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
Data engineering experience, such as:
Building ETL/ELT pipelines
Working with event-based ingestion and structured logs (e.g., user sessions, reactions, feeds)
Using tools like BigQuery, Airflow, or dbt
Designing or consuming feature stores for AI/ML applications

At Luupli, we believe in building something extraordinary together. This role is equity-only at this stage, meaning you’re not just working for Luupli, you’re building it with us. If you’re driven by impact, excited to shape the future of social media, and ready to share in the upside of what we’re creating, this is your chance to be part of the founding story.

At Klaviyo, we believe the future of software lies not in productivity tools for human users but in software that can run and optimize itself based on outcome or reward metrics. We’ve built the infrastructure and application that serve as the interface between businesses and consumers. We now have over 183,000 customers, billions of consumer profiles, and hundreds of billions of customer messages and follow-on conversion data. About the role

At Klaviyo, our Engineering team builds the foundational technologies that power how brands grow through owned marketing. As an AI Engineer at Klaviyo, you’ll play a key role in designing and building scalable backend systems and user experiences that power our AI products and AI agent solutions. You’ll partner closely with product managers, machine learning engineers, and software engineers, to drive real-world impact at scale. This is a backend-heavy role with opportunities to influence architecture, async processing pipelines, distributed systems, and more.

This is an opportunity to apply your generative AI and agentic AI application skills in a production environment. You’ll be embedded within one of our engineering teams and work on meaningful projects that help customers interact with powerful marketing tools, all while building a strong technical foundation and connections across Klaviyo.

Early career talent comes to Klaviyo with experience in a variety of technical skills, but they are all passionate about building, owning and scaling features end-to-end from scratch and breaking through any obstacle or technical challenge in their way. Design and build backend systems that support scaling our AI solutions for 183K+ customers.
Develop robust, reliable and scalable services to serve AI models in production environments.
Contribute to evolving our agentic architecture — making our AI agents more self-sufficient and performant.
Contribute to a culture of ownership, experimentation, and customer-centric product thinking.
Engage with internal stakeholders to understand their needs and resolve blockers.
Stay abreast of emerging AI trends and technologies, identifying and leveraging opportunities for their application within Klaviyo’s ecosystem.
Work with the team on project planning and defining achievements, identifying dependencies, and meeting business goals.

Pursuing an advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field, Graduating in December 2025 or May/June 2026

Previous internship experience in AI, machine learning, or related fields, with a strong interest in building and deploying AI projects.

Name: Ed Hallen
Post Content:
Team Overview
The Infrastructure Security team makes it simple and easy for engineers to make secure choices while developing world-class software at high speed. Security is built in by default—seamless and effortless—making engineers’ lives better and Klaviyo more secure.

Our work sits at the intersection of security, infrastructure, and software engineering. We build cloud-native platforms and services that are reliable, secure, and performant at global scale, forming the foundation that Klaviyo engineers rely on every day.

This role is for engineers who enjoy building modern distributed systems, care about security and reliability, and want to have real impact across a large engineering organization.

How you’ll make an impact
As a Software Engineer on the Infrastructure Security team, you will build and operate the systems that help Klaviyo engineers ship secure software with confidence. You will:

Design, build, and maintain cloud-native security services used across Klaviyo
Own meaningful components and services end to end, from implementation through production operation
Improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of infrastructure security systems
Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture, contributing ideas and technical solutions
Identify performance, reliability, and security issues in distributed systems and drive improvements
Work extensively with technologies such as Python, Golang, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern data stores
Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, and whiteboarding sessions
Contribute to operational excellence through monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Participate in an on-call rotation with a focus on learning, prevention, and reducing operational toil
Build tooling, automation, and documentation that improve developer experience and security posture
Partner with product-facing and platform engineers to ship impactful, secure solutions
Who you are
You have solid experience building and operating cloud-native, distributed systems in production
You are comfortable writing production-quality code in a language such as Python or Go
You have hands-on experience with AWS (or a similar cloud provider) and understand managed services, networking, and IAM concepts
You have experience working with containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes
You are comfortable owning services and features independently, while knowing when to ask for feedback or support
You understand the fundamentals of scalable, multi-tenant architectures and secure system design
You care about reliability, performance, observability, and security—not just shipping features
You are comfortable participating in on-call and responding to production issues
You communicate clearly, collaborate well, and enjoy working through technical problems as a team
You regularly use modern developer tooling, including AI-powered tools, to improve productivity and code quality
Nice to have
Experience building or integrating security-focused systems (e.g. secrets management, IAM, authn/z, policy enforcement)
Familiarity with service meshes, API gateways, or zero-trust architectures
Experience improving performance in distributed systems or debugging complex multi-service workflows
Tech Stack
Klaviyo’s platform is primarily built with Python and React and runs on AWS. Engineers join us from a wide range of technical backgrounds and are supported in learning our stack. Core technologies include:

Python / Django / FastAPI
MySQL / Redis / Memcached
RabbitMQ / Celery / Apache Kafka / Apache Pulsar
AWS / Terraform / Kubernetes
Location & Work Model
This role is based in Dublin, Ireland and follows a hybrid working model. Klaviyo supports work authorization and relocation for this position.

At Klaviyo, we enjoy tackling meaningful engineering challenges and value people who take ownership, learn continuously, and collaborate openly. We are committed to building inclusive teams and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Name: Ed Hallen
Post Content:
Klaviyo is seeking a GTM (Go-to-Market) Technology Software Developer Co-op to join our Global Technology Solutions team. In this role, you’ll help build and improve the software, integrations, and automation that power how our employees and internal teams work every day.

You’ll work on our Go-to-Market Systems Team, supporting the tech stack across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Partnerships. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll write production code, collaborate closely with stakeholders, and ship solutions that have immediate internal impact.

How You Will Make an Impact:
Build and enhance APIs, integrations, and automations across GTM technology systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, and Hubspot)
Collaborate with engineers and internal stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions
Improve internal user experiences by simplifying workflows, reducing manual steps, and increasing system reliability
Participate in agile development practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, testing, and iterative delivery
Write clear technical documentation and support testing across multiple user personas
Support audit and compliance efforts through thoughtful system design, logging, and documentation
Explore opportunities to apply modern tooling and automation to make internal systems more efficient
You’ll thrive in this role if you:

Enjoy shipping code early and often in an agile fashion while partnering with business users to craft better software by soliciting feedback and understanding business needs
Embrace Klaviyo’s “always learning” culture that fosters learning at every level, constantly pushing yourself to be a better engineer
You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.
Who You Are:
Undergraduate student graduating between December 2026 – May 2028 pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field
Have completed at least one prior software engineering internship or co-op
Experience with one or more Python, Java, JavaScript
Familiarity with APIs, databases, or web technologies
Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable learning new systems and domains
Strong problem-solving skills and enjoy working through ambiguity
Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating with both technical and non-technical partners
Detail-oriented and interested in building reliable, maintainable internal systems
Co-op Logistics

Our Fall Co-op Program is a 6-month paid experience, July 6th-December 18th, 2026 at our Boston, MA headquarters. Co-ops are required to be in the office 5 days a week.
Before diving into individual teams and projects, all co-ops will complete Klaviyo Base Camp - our customized onboarding experience. Base Camp provides focused time to learn about Klaviyo, our product, the ins and outs of engineering, and spend time getting to know other interns. This robust training experience ensures all interns join their teams fully prepared to dive into project work and make an immediate impact.
Our Boston office is fun! Our co-ops stay fueled with free snacks and drinks, take breaks over a game of ping pong, Nintendo Switch, or a round of golf in our golf simulator, and relax in our speakeasy.
Throughout the program, Klaviyo co-ops attend social events to promote interaction beyond team and project work. In past years these events have included a Red Sox game, outings to Versus and Flight Club in the Boston Seaport, ice cream socials, and Ask Me Anything sessions with Klaviyo senior leadership.

Affinity stitches together billions of data points from massive datasets to create a powerful, accurate representation of the world's professional relationship graph. You will design and build LLM-powered AI systems that efficiently uncover insights from compelling business interaction data – an exciting and unique opportunity within the industry.

Build LLM powered agent systems: Contribute to design and orchestration of multi-agent LLM systems using community frameworks and custom orchestration layers.
Solve complex problems: Work on a variety of information extraction, information storage and information retrieval problems for both structured and unstructured data.

Experience with developing AI applications powered by agent-based systems
Experience with packaging, CI/CD and pipeline automation.
